rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Royal Order A/80 of 1/3/1422 AH (SPA series عام/اوامر ملكية كريمة, fifteenth addition) forms the Shura Council of 'the Chairman and the members named' for four Hijri years starting from the date on which the current council, formed by Royal Order A/72 of 2/3/1418, ends. The list begins 'الشيخ محمد بن ابراهيم بن جبير / رئيس مجلس الشورى', then Bakri bin Salih Shatta as Vice Chairman.
rows.locator: SPA series صدور اضافة خامسة عشرة: order number and date, clause First and the first two entries

rows.text: The 1422 AH orders cite Royal Order A/72 of 2/3/1418 as the order that formed the then-current (second) council and Royal Order A/62 of 1/3/1418 as the order amending Article 3.
Royal Order A/78 of 1/3/1422 AH amends the opening of Article 3, as already amended by A/62 of 1/3/1418, to read 'a Chairman and one hundred and twenty members'.
rows.locator: SPA series صدور اضافة ثالثة عشرة

rows.role_title: نائب رئيس مجلس الشورى — Vice Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Royal Order A/79 of 1/3/1422 AH appoints Bakri bin Salih Shatta (printed الاستاذ بكرى بن صالح شطا) Vice Chairman of the Shura Council with the rank of minister, with effect from 3/3/1422; it recites Royal Order A/14 of 3/3/1414.
rows.locator: SPA series صدور اضافة رابعة عشرة

rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: King Fahd writes to 'معالى رئيس مجلس الشورى الشيخ محمد بن ابراهيم بن جبير' to mark the end of the Council's second term and its formation for a third, thanking the members whose membership has ended.
rows.locator: SPA series صدور الاضافة الرابعة والعشرون واخيرة

rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: SPA, Riyadh 18 Rabi I 1422 / 10 June 2001: the Council held the second ordinary session of the first year of its third term 'برئاسة معالى رئيس المجلس فضيلة الشيخ محمد بن ابراهيم بن جبير'.
rows.locator: Dateline الرياض 18 ربيع الاول 1422 الموافق 10 يونيو 2001 (session item)

rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: SPA, Riyadh 19 Rabi I 1422 / 11 June 2001: the Chairman received a Chinese message congratulating him on 'the royal trust in extending his service as Chairman of the Shura Council for its third term'.
rows.locator: Dateline الرياض 19 ربيع الاول 1422 الموافق 11 يونيو 2001
